project_name: ProFab MES/APS - Sistema de Controle de Chão de Fábrica e Planejamento

responsive.mobile_strategy: Direct operator interface with 48px+ touch targets, single-column stacked layout, sticky bottom control bar, big visible digital chronometer, one-touch scrap and stoppage reason selectors.
responsive.tablet_strategy: 2-column grid for shop-floor stations. Left side showing active OP drawing/specs and real-time timer, right side for quick piece counter (+1, +5, +10) and stoppage log.
responsive.desktop_strategy: Supervisors/PCP high-density command center with live machine matrix, validation queue drawer, OEE gauge cards, Pareto stoppage chart, and OP aging table with modals for CRUD actions.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use max-w-full overflow-x-hidden on container divs, custom horizontal scrolling wrappers for data tables with shadow cues.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height x 48px width for all operator buttons, status toggles, and counter increments.

typography.font_pairings: Chivo for section titles & card headings, IBM Plex Mono for numeric values (timers, piece counters, OEE percentages, OP numbers), Inter for body descriptions and table data.

type_scale.timer_display: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-mono font-black tracking-widest tabular-nums
type_scale.metric_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
type_scale.badge: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md

colors.theme_mode: dual_mode_industrial (light industrial base default, dark tactical toggle available)
colors.contrast_rules: Status badges must use high-contrast solid backgrounds with white text or deep tinted background with dark text (min 4.5:1 ratio). Numeric counters use dark slate or bright emerald for high visibility across factory floor light conditions.

visual_enhancers.card_style: Industrial card with 1px border (#E2E8F0 / #2A344A), rounded-lg corners, zero harsh gloss, micro shadow-sm on hover.
visual_enhancers.timer_box: High-contrast digital readout container with subtle grid texture background, glow ring when active (#10B981 pulse), dark background box with neon emerald numbers for maximum distance glanceability.
visual_enhancers.modal_style: Shadcn Dialog overlay with clean header, explicit form fields, tabbed validation views for supervisor approval, and sticky footer action buttons.
visual_enhancers.toast_style: Sonner toasts anchored to top-right/bottom-right for supervisor alerts when new OPs enter 'Pendente Aprovação' or when a line stoppage is reported.

key_components.name: Header & Mode Switcher
key_components.purpose: Displays company logo, system status (Online / Off-line LAN), active shop floor shift info, pending approvals badge counter, view toggle (Operador vs Supervisor), and theme switch.

key_components.name: Operador View - Chronometer & Production Logger
key_components.purpose: Tablet-optimized view for shop-floor operators. OP selector dropdown/card, big live chronometer (Start/Pause/Resume/Finish), counter (+1, +5, +10, -1) for produced good pieces, scrap count input with reason tag, and 1-click stoppage reason selector (e.g. Falha Mecânica, Falta de Matéria-Prima, Troca de Ferramenta).

key_components.name: Supervisor Live Floor Matrix
key_components.purpose: Grid of machine cards (Torno CNC 01, Centro de Usinagem 02, Prensa Hidráulica, Corte Laser, etc.) showing active OP, assigned operator avatar & name, live timer, pieces produced vs goal progress bar, and real-time status light.

key_components.name: Validation Queue (Pendente de Aprovação)
key_components.purpose: List/Drawer of reports submitted by operators awaiting supervisor validation. Quick approve / edit / reject actions with modal detail review.

key_components.name: OEE Analytics Dashboard
key_components.purpose: OEE overall gauge card + breakdown into Availability (Disponibilidade), Performance (Desempenho), and Quality (Qualidade). Filterable by machine, shift, operator, and date range.

key_components.name: Pareto Stoppage Chart (Gráfico de Pareto - Paradas)
key_components.purpose: Recharts combination of Bar Chart (hours lost per stoppage reason) and Line Chart (cumulative percentage line) to highlight top bottleneck causes.

key_components.name: OP Aging & Delivery Schedule (Aging de Ordens de Produção)
key_components.purpose: Table and timeline showing OPs sorted by status and delivery lead time, highlighting overdue OPs (>24h delay in red badge) and pending items.

key_components.name: Operator Productivity Matrix
key_components.purpose: Performance table displaying pieces/hour, % scrap, % downtime, and total shift uptime per operator.

key_components.name: CRUD Modals (Cadastros Básicos)
key_components.purpose: Modals for Supervisor to manage Operators (Operadores), Machines (Máquinas), Technical Drawings (Desenhos com Anexo PDF/Imagem), and Production Orders (OPs).

factory_lathe.description: Oficina industrial com torno CNC e aparas de usinagem.
factory_lathe.usage: Background/Header banner for CNC machine detail card or Technical Drawing preview modal.

factory_operators.description: Operadores alinhados executando rotina em máquina industrial.
factory_operators.usage: Hero banner for Supervisor Dashboard or Operator Onboarding banner.

lathe_close_up.description: Detalhe de placa e cabeçote de máquina ferramenta.

operator_working.usage: Avatar / profile badge for active operator profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION PHASES: Ensure both 'Visão do Operador (Chão de Fábrica)' and 'Visão do Supervisor / PCP' are fully navigable via top tabs or mode toggle.

2. CHRONOMETER ENGINE: In Operador View, build a robust functional JS timer (useEffect + setInterval) with Start (Iniciar), Pause (Pausar), Resume (Retomar), and Finish (Finalizar Apontamento). Show live time formatted as HH:MM:SS in large monospace numbers.

3. PIECE COUNTERS: Operadores need big touchable (+1, +5, +10, -1) buttons for produced good pieces (Peças Boas) and a dedicated modal/input for Refugo (Scrap) with reason selector (ex: Defeito Usinagem, Riscado, Fora de Tolerância).

4. STOPPAGE TRACKING (Paradas): Include 1-click stoppage buttons with presets (Manutenção Corretiva, Falta de Material, Setup/Troca Ferramenta, Aguardando Inspeção PCP, Queda de Energia). Activating a stoppage changes timer state to Amber and tracks downtime duration.
5. SUPERVISOR DASHBOARD: Display real-time KPI summary bar (OPs Ativas, OEE Médio, Eficiência de Peças, OPs Atrasadas, Pendências Supervisor).
6. CHARTS WITH RECHARTS: Build Pareto Chart (ComposedChart with Bar for hours lost + Line for cumulative %) and OEE Radial / Gauge or Bar breakdown charts.

7. MODALS FOR SUPERVISOR CRUD: Inline forms must be replaced with Shadcn Dialog Modals for creating/editing Operators, Machines, Drawings (Desenhos), and OPs. Include filter bars (periodo, maquina, operador, cliente, OP).
8. NOTIFICATIONS & TOASTS: Use Sonner toast alerts when supervisor approves/rejects an apontamento, or when a high-priority stoppage is registered on the floor.
9. EXPORT & SEARCH: Add CSV/Excel download export simulation button for production reports and filtering across tables.

10. ALL INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS MUST HAVE data-testid ATTRIBUTES (e.g. data-testid='start-timer-btn', data-testid='inc-piece-btn', data-testid='stoppage-reason-btn', data-testid='op-filter-select', data-testid='modal-add-op-btn').
